title: Sprint close and drop delete the refs/kb-reopened ref of each item they remove
goal: backlog.py close (and drop outside a sprint) deletes refs/kb-reopened/<id>, the done file reopen keeps since BG-hc3daknv, for each item it deletes, so the clone holds no such ref for an item that no longer exists; the operator kept the ref namespace in the SP-qzip6qar review and asked for its cleanup. Today 11 refs stay in the clone after SP-qzip6qar's review reopened its items.

run: import os,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['git','for-each-ref','--format=%(refname:lstrip=2)','refs/kb-reopened/'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True);gone=[i for i in r.stdout.split() if not os.path.exists(os.path.join('kb','_self','backlog',i+'.json'))];print('refs of removed items:',gone);sys.exit(1 if gone else 0)

notes: The check passes while the reopened items still have files; it fails from the moment SP-qzip6qar's close deletes them with their 11 refs still in the clone.
